reviews.title: Nice addition/replacement for a great price
reviews.comment: I was in the market for a nice, cheap addition to my gaming setup to go with my RGB mouse and keyboard. I didn't want to spend much, so $16 seemed good to me. It does what it says. It has 11 modes: all colors can be static, 1 "breathing" color wheel cycle, and 1 "rainbow slow fade" color wheel cycle. It's slim and doesn't slide, stays put. The side port on the pad is micro USB, and the length of cord is generous so you shouldn't have a problem reaching your box within reason. It comes rolled up, so it might take a bit of time to "fully lay flat", but it's not bad or a deal breaker. I recommend it for a cheap pick up, not sure what more else someone would want out of it. Update: 2 months later, still great! Everything works still, doesn't slide, and lays perfectly flat.
reviews.author: Blerp

reviews.title: Good buy
reviews.comment: I bought this for my husband, he's happy with it. Great texture, it's smooth, easy to use with a mouse, sits flat, really great quality! You can have it set to one color, or switching colors
reviews.author: Kaylee Beerbower

reviews.title: Mouse pad
reviews.comment: I'm so blessed to be the proud owner of this awesome mouse pad. Gaming is extremely important to my husband and I that the products we use have to be top notch, well this fantastic mouse pad truly fits the bill. The lighting is perfect, and the pad is very easy to wipe down if needed. The mouse moves so smoothly, very important. Highly recommend!!!
reviews.author: Lora Kempson

reviews.title: Love it mostly
reviews.comment: Ordered one to see if it was what I wanted, it was. The size of my laptop table was literally two of these side by side. So I ordered a second one. The only problem I have is that the colors don't match, for example yellow on the first is a gold color and on the second one it's a dandelion yellow. Really the only color that matches almost completely and isn't annoyingly noticable is the green. I would recommend this if you only need 1 or if you want to get someone a gift. But I would never recommend getting two to have side by side or anything and the RGB cycle speed is off as well, which after about 4 minutes its annoying noticable as well
reviews.author: Joseph

reviews.title: Wonderful gaming mousepad!
reviews.comment: I use this mousepad for gaming.  It is a very sleek design and works great with my mouse.  I am able to move this mousepad easily between several computers for gaming and general use.  Seems to be well built and the lights on the edge work perfectly every time!  Some mousepads are too small.  This one is just the right size.  Great value for money!  Highly recommended!
reviews.author: Tracy M.
